prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Use Ctrl+Pet to interact, hide, or customize your companion right on your screen.", "Companion Active", "Press Alt+P anytime to open quick desktop controls."]
1: ["Inspect & Fine-Tune Pet Aesthetics", "Choose rendering styles and preview lighting before generating your desktop companion.", "Confirm Visual Style"]
2: ["Select Your Companion Journey", "Compare companion behavior styles side-by-side to find your ideal match.", "Preset Companion", "Custom AI Companion"]
3: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock your newly created pet identity and sync across desktop devices."]
4: ["Notice: Returning users should sign in with their original account to preserve existing pets."]
5: ["Preparing Desktop Environment...", "Allocating Desktop Space", "Rendering Companion Sprites"]
6: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Click your pet to interact. Right-click for options or press Shift+Esc to temporarily hide it."]
7: ["Upload Pet Photos in Grid View", "Ensure clear lighting and centered framing for the best companion rendering result."]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Seal Verified"]
9: ["You will get a system notification as soon as your pet lands on your desktop."]
